story.text: 카페를 나선 우리는 딱히 정하지 않은 걸음으로 걷다가, 어느새 경복궁 돌담을 따라 걷고 있었다.
story.reading: ka-pe-reul na-seon u-ri-neun ttak-hi jeong-ha-ji an-eun geol-eum-eu-ro geot-da-ga, eo-neu-sae gyeong-bok-gung dol-dam-eul tta-ra geot-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: Leaving the cafe, we walked without any particular destination, and before long we found ourselves walking along the stone walls of Gyeongbokgung.

story.text: 그는 담장 너머로 살짝 보이는 궁궐 지붕을 가리켰다. '저 지붕 곡선, 자세히 보면 예쁘지 않아요? 저는 이 노선을 다닐 때마다 하늘에서 저걸 봐요.'
story.reading: geu-neun dam-jang neo-meo-ro sal-jjak bo-i-neun gung-gwol ji-bung-eul ga-ri-kyeot-da. jeo ji-bung gok-seon, ja-se-hi bo-myeon ye-ppeu-ji an-a-yo? jeo-neun i no-seon-eul da-nil ttae-ma-da ha-neul-e-seo jeo-geol bwa-yo.
story.en: He pointed to the palace roof peeking over the wall. "If you look closely at that curve, isn't it beautiful? Every time I fly this route, I see it from up in the sky."

story.text: 평소의 장난기 대신, 그의 목소리엔 뜻밖의 잔잔함이 묻어 있었다. 그는 궁궐의 역사를 하나씩 짚어가며 설명하기 시작했다.
story.reading: pyeong-so-ui jang-nan-gi dae-sin, geu-ui mok-so-ri-en tteut-bakk-ui jan-jan-ham-i mud-eo iss-eot-da. geu-neun gung-gwol-ui yeok-sa-reul ha-na-ssik jip-eo-ga-myeo seol-myeong-ha-gi si-jak-haet-da.
story.en: Instead of his usual playfulness, there was an unexpected calm in his voice. He began explaining the palace's history, piece by piece.

story.text: '이런 이야기, 아무한테나 막 하고 다니는 거 아니에요. 그냥… 아가씨한테는 좀 더 알려주고 싶어서요.'
story.reading: i-reon i-ya-gi, a-mu-han-te-na mak ha-go da-ni-neun geo a-ni-e-yo. geu-nyang… a-ga-ssi-han-te-neun jom deo al-lyeo-ju-go sip-eo-seo-yo.
story.en: "This kind of story — I don't just go around telling it to anyone. I just... wanted to share more of it with you, specifically."

story.text: 능청스럽던 평소와 달리, 그 순간만큼은 정말 순수하게 이 도시를 아끼는 사람처럼 보였다. 나는 그 낯선 진지함이 오히려 마음에 들었다.
story.reading: neung-cheong-seu-reop-deon pyeong-so-wa dal-li, geu sun-gan-man-keum-eun jeong-mal sun-su-ha-ge i do-si-reul a-kki-neun sa-ram-cheo-reom bo-yeot-da. na-neun geu nat-seon jin-ji-ham-i o-hi-ryeo ma-eum-e deul-eot-da.
story.en: Unlike his usual smooth-talking self, in that moment he looked like someone who genuinely cared about this city. I found that unfamiliar sincerity strangely appealing.

story.text: 시선이 마주치자 그는 살짝 당황한 듯 헛기침을 했다. '왜 그렇게 봐요? 저 이럴 때만 진지해지는 거 아니거든요. …아, 아닌가.'
story.reading: si-seon-i ma-ju-chi-ja geu-neun sal-jjak dang-hwang-han deut heot-gi-chim-eul haet-da. wae geu-reo-ke bwa-yo? jeo i-reol ttae-man jin-ji-hae-ji-neun geo a-ni-geo-deun-yo. …a, a-nin-ga.
story.en: When our eyes met, he seemed a little flustered and cleared his throat. "Why are you looking at me like that? I'm not only serious at moments like this, you know. ...or, well, maybe I am."

story.text: 궁궐 지붕 너머로 노을이 번지고 있었다. 그리고 나는, 이 사람의 다른 얼굴을 조금 더 보고 싶어졌다.
story.reading: gung-gwol ji-bung neo-meo-ro no-eul-i beon-ji-go iss-eot-da. geu-ri-go na-neun, i sa-ram-ui da-reun eol-gul-eul jo-geum deo bo-go sip-eo-jyeot-da.
story.en: The sunset was spreading beyond the palace roof. And I found myself wanting to see a little more of this other side of him.

words.example_en: The stone wall path of Gyeongbokgung was beautiful.
The curve of the palace roof is impressive.

words.example: 그는 서울의 역사를 잘 알고 있었다.

words.example_en: He told me a story about the palace.
